name: job-recommender-web
description: Candidate CV upload & review web module (React + Express + PostgreSQL, on top of the existing Python cv_parser service).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
